study.notes: STUDY: Quan 2017 (Exp Ther Med 14:3279-3287, open access, group 203 full text rendered from the PDF), three phase crossover study in 200 overweight or obese patients newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, randomised evenly (n 100 per group): Phase I (12 weeks) group A exenatide 5 ug twice daily for 4 weeks then 10 ug twice daily plus metformin 0.5 g twice daily (dose_mg 0.01 per injection) vs group B biphasic insulin aspart 30 (0.3 to 0.4 U/kg/day) plus metformin; Phase II metformin alone; Phase III the treatments swapped; only the Phase I contrast is used (a parallel randomised comparison before any crossover), Table II; the table legend says mean ± standard error of the mean but the magnitudes (weight 81 ± 16 kg, n 100) are only consistent with standard deviations, so the dispersion is read as SD (route arm_change_imputed_r, correlation 0.5; within arm p in the row notes); no attrition described, n 100 per group taken as analysed; pct_weight_change -7.12 computed by the session from the text: group A -3.2 kg on 81 kg = -3.95 percent, group B +2.6 kg on 82 kg = +3.17 percent, corrected -7.12 percentage points; outcomes not ranked as primary or secondary (prespecified FALSE); supported by the Key Science Planning Program of Hainan Province (industry_funded FALSE); rob_overall high

rows.notes: Table II Phase I: FBG mmol/L, baseline and 12 weeks per group (within arm p 0.002 and 0.019); the insulin arm fell more (unfavourable contrast)
Table II Phase I: HbA1c percent, baseline and 12 weeks per group (within arm p 0.001 both)
Table II Phase I: triglycerides mmol/L
Table II Phase I: total cholesterol mmol/L
Table II Phase I: LDL cholesterol mmol/L
Table II Phase I: fasting insulin pmol/L
Table II Phase I: fasting C peptide nmol/L; the insulin arm rose
Table II Phase I: adiponectin (unit printed pg/ml, implausibly low for a total adiponectin assay; kept as printed)
Table II Phase I: TNF-alpha pg/ml (high absolute values for the ELISA named, kept as printed)
Table II Phase I: CRP mg/l by an ELISA with sensitivity below 2 pg/ml, recorded under hsCRP

json.design: randomised three phase crossover study, 200 patients newly diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, Phase I parallel contrast (12 weeks) exenatide plus metformin vs biphasic insulin aspart 30 plus metformin
json.reason: full text group (open access PDF rendered to text); eleven inventory markers from Table II (Phase I) by the imputed change route
other_markers: Phases II and III (carry over and crossover, not used)

rob.justification: S: randomised without a described method (D1); open treatment with insulin titration and no blinding described (D2 high); no attrition reported for 200 randomised (D3 some concerns); laboratory outcomes (D4 low); no registration, inflammatory markers added to the statistical plan post hoc per the text (D5 some concerns)

doubts: the table legend says SEM, the magnitudes say SD; read as SD
units of adiponectin (pg/ml) and TNF-alpha (380 pg/ml) are implausible for the assays named; values kept as printed
two column PDF rendering: the table rows were read from the rendered text, not from the PDF image
